title: 第379章 认知超前于意识？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

刘盈把远处发生的一切看在眼中，他是真的没有想到，公孙玲珑一个医者，竟然也会有这么可爱的一面。

夜幕来临，刘盈本来打算在草原上溜达一下的，结果骑着马走了没多远，迎面就有许多的小飞虫，往脸上飞撞过来。

不仅如此，这些小虫最为可恶的地方在于，会向着人的眼睛飞来，一不小心就感觉眼睛一阵火燎般的刺痛，随后眼泪也止不住的往下掉。

刘盈也就没了精神，唯独好在汉军都已经进入城中，没有进入城中的人，也在外边扎营，不至于被这些飞虫蚊子折磨。

回到城中，刘盈还是只能住在城楼上的帐篷里边。

一天的时间，汉军也没有办法直接就修筑出来房子。

嬴月、靠山、臧儿几人凑在一块，开始商量着美食的问题。

安澜在一边上擦剑。

刘盈忽然发现就自己现在空闲下来，这个时候去找韩信学习兵法，显然不太合适。

香姬和韩信阔别那么久的时间，自然有说不完的话。

尤其是刘盈走出大帐后，看到韩忠在两个护卫的护卫下怕城楼，他就知道自己这个时候更加不能去找韩信。

指不定大军回去的时候，韩忠还能多出来一个弟弟或者是妹妹。

李左车不知道什么时候，也到了城楼上，他看到刘盈穿着裘衣，站在城楼上头，便快步走了过来。

“殿下！”

李左车微微抱拳。

刘盈颔首道：“军中无需多礼，夜色已经深了，将军为何还不去安歇？”

“一路北上，虽然说谷蠡单于臣服，但是行军在外，多一份小心自然不会是错的，臣打算每天晚上睡觉前，都巡视一下城楼。”

刘盈一愣，觉得自己这个大军主将，这个时候真的是有点甩手掌柜的感觉。

“草原上昼夜气候相差很大，将军还是需要保重身体才是。”

刘盈只好以此言宽慰李左车。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Liu Ying saw everything that happened in the distance. He really didn't expect that Gongsun Linglong, a doctor, would have such a cute side.

As night fell, Liu Ying originally planned to take a walk on the grassland, but not far away on her horse, she encountered many small flying insects flying towards her face.

Not only that, the most disgusting thing about these little bugs is that they will fly towards people's eyes. If you are not careful, you will feel a burning sting in your eyes, and then tears will fall down uncontrollably.

Liu Ying lost her energy. Fortunately, all the Han troops had entered the city. Those who had not entered the city were also camping outside, so they would not be tortured by these flying insects and mosquitoes.

Back in the city, Liu Ying could only live in a tent on the tower.

In one day, the Han army could not build a house directly.

Ying Yue, Guoshan, and Zang'er gathered together and began to discuss the issue of delicious food.

An Lan was cleaning his sword on the side.

Liu Ying suddenly realized that she was free now, so it was obviously not appropriate to go to Han Xin to learn the art of war at this time.

Xiang Ji and Han Xin had been apart for so long, so naturally they had endless things to say.

Especially after Liu Ying walked out of the tent and saw Han Zhong fearing the tower under the protection of two guards, he knew that he could not go to Han Xin at this time.

Maybe when the army returns, Han Zhong will have another younger brother or younger sister.

Li Zuoche arrived at the tower at some unknown time. He saw Liu Ying wearing fur clothes standing on the tower, and walked over quickly.

"Your Highness!"

Li Zuoche clasped his fists slightly.

Liu Ying nodded and said: "There is no need to be polite in the army. The night is already dark. Why doesn't the general go and rest?"

"Going all the way north, although Gu Li Shanyu surrenders, it is not wrong to be more careful while marching. I plan to inspect the tower every night before going to bed."

Liu Ying was stunned for a moment, feeling that she, the commander-in-chief of the army, really felt a little like the boss at this time.

"The climate varies greatly between day and night on the grassland. The general still needs to take care of himself."

Liu Ying had no choice but to comfort Li Zuoche with these words.
